data.narrative:
Reditus Space is a Seed-stage space & aerospace company founded by Stef Crum (CEO, PhD in Space Systems Engineering from Georgia Tech with prior NASA and Space Force orbital operations experience) and Will Sherman (CTO, Georgia Tech aerospace). The company has raised $7.1M to date. The broader Space & Aerospace sector includes 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) trading at a median 24.6x revenue multiple, and 8 private peers including Starcloud, SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, and Sierra Space.

Of three valuation methods tested, only Stage-Progression proved applicable. Using the $7.1M total raised as a proxy for current valuation and applying a typical 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier yields an implied valuation of $18M. Peer-Median analysis could not be applied due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables in the narrow aerospace cohort (only 1 same-stage private peer identified). Public-Comp anchoring was inapplicable because target revenue is not disclosed, preventing meaningful P/S multiple application despite the 24.6x sector median.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $15M to $20M, with a median of $18M. This range reflects the stage-progression method applied conservatively (low end) and optimistically (high end). Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue data, which precludes revenue-multiple triangulation, and the thinly populated peer set for private Seed-stage aerospace firms. The founder team's deep government and operational aerospace background provides qualitative support, but cannot be quantified within this framework.
